title: Order Fee Clause for Northgate Purchases & Returns: Delivery Fee and Non-Member Surcharge
content:
This clause of Northgate Purchases & Returns governs the two order-level fees set when a purchase is made — the delivery fee and the non-member surcharge — and how order fees are refunded.

## Delivery fee

The channel's delivery fee is charged once per order on channels that have one, except that it is not charged:

- when the order's merchandise total (the sum of the line amounts of the items sold on the purchase) is at or above the channel's free-delivery threshold, where that threshold is not zero; and
- when the channel waives the fee for Plus-tier memberships and the membership on the purchase was held at Northgate Club Plus Membership or Northgate Business Plus Membership on the order date.

| Non-zero threshold reached | Plus waiver on the channel and Plus tier held on the order date | Delivery fee due |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | none |
| yes | no | none |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | the channel's delivery fee |

## Non-member surcharge

The non-member surcharge is the channel's surcharge percentage of the order's merchandise total, rounded to the cent, and is charged only on a channel that sells to non-members when the membership on the purchase did not have status active on the order date. A member who renews later does not get the surcharge back, but it is refunded line by line with returned merchandise where the channel refunds the surcharge with the line.

Hypothetical: a non-member's order with a merchandise total of 150.12 on a channel with a 5 percent surcharge carries a surcharge of 7.506, rounded to 7.51.

## Other fees and refunds of fees

Restocking and changed-mind pickup fees are charged only as the return terms provide. A fee is refunded in full by its own fee refund entry when the order is cancelled, and the delivery fee when the return terms provide. A fee is never refunded twice.
